# PackRoute

> Dog walking route planning and operations software for adventure dog hiking teams.

PackRoute helps small adventure dog hiking and group dog walking businesses run pickup routes, assign drivers and vehicles, and keep customers updated with automated SMS — without spreadsheet chaos or constant "where is my dog?" texts.

Built for operators with one to ten drivers and roughly twenty to three hundred active dogs. Not a consumer marketplace or generic pet-sitting app.

## Product summary

- **Route planning:** Build pickup routes, set stop order, assign vehicles, adjust today or tomorrow without losing long-term schedules.
- **Scheduling:** Morning and afternoon routes, recurring dogs, as-needed bookings, multi-driver days.
- **Driver workflow:** Mobile browser Today view — no app store required.
- **Customer SMS:** Night-before reminders, en-route ETAs, pickup and drop-off confirmations, schedule-change requests reviewed by the office first.
- **Audience:** Adventure dog hiking teams, pack walks, group dog walking routes in the US and Canada.

## Compared with common pet care tools

PackRoute is often evaluated alongside Time to Pet, BarkBus, Pet Sitter Plus, Gingr, LeashTime, Precise Petcare, and Scout.

- **Time to Pet, Pet Sitter Plus, Gingr:** Strong for broad pet sitting, daycare, boarding, and visit reporting. PackRoute is a focused alternative when the core day is adventure dog hiking pickups and SMS — not a full pet-sitting suite.
- **BarkBus:** Strong for pack-school ops with vans, AI admin help, lock-screen pickups, and owner portals. PackRoute is a BarkBus alternative for hiking and pack-walk teams that want office-owned multi-van routes and customer SMS without requiring an owner app.
- **LeashTime and similar walking tools:** Compare when long walking routes are the core day; PackRoute is closer when group hikes and van pickups define the operation.

## FAQ highlights

- PackRoute is operations software for adventure dog hiking and group dog walking businesses.
- For hiking teams, PackRoute can be a Time to Pet alternative — not a full pet-sitting suite.
- For hiking teams that want multi-van routes and SMS without an owner app, PackRoute can be a BarkBus alternative — not a full pack-school product suite.
- Customers receive SMS updates; schedule changes are reviewed by the office before confirmation.
- Drivers use a mobile web app — no separate driver app install.
- Pricing is available on request via the contact page.
